an3.59:1.1: 60 athakho jānussoṇī brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho jānussoṇī brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an3.59:1.2: yassassu bho gotama yañño vā saddhaṃ vā thālipāko vā deyyadhammaṃ vā tevijjesu brāhmaṇesu dānaṃ dadeyyāti.
an3.59:1.3: yathā kathaṃ pana brāhmaṇa brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ tevijjaṃ paññāpentīti.
an3.59:1.4: idha bho gotama brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto hoti mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena ajjhāyako mantadharo tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayoti
an3.59:1.5: evaṃ kho bho gotama brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ tevijjaṃ paññāpentīti.
an3.59:2.1: aññathā kho brāhmaṇa brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ tevijjaṃ paññāpenti aññathā ca pana ariyassa vinaye tevijjo hotīti.
an3.59:2.2: yathākathaṃ pana bho gotama ariyassa vinaye tevijjo hoti
an3.59:2.3: sādhu me bhavaṃ gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathā ariyassa vinaye tevijjo hotīti.
an3.59:2.4: tenahi brāhmaṇa suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi bhāsissāmīti.
an3.59:2.5: evaṃ bhoti kho jānussoṇī brāhmaṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
an3.59:4.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatupakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti
an3.59:4.4: avijjā vihatā vijjā uppannā tamo vihato āloko uppanno yathātaṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato.
an3.59:5.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatupakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte sattānaṃ cutupapātañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti
an3.59:5.2: so dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati …pe…
an3.59:5.4: avijjā vihatā vijjā uppannā tamo vihato āloko uppanno yathātaṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato.
an3.59:6.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatupakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti
an3.59:6.2: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an3.59:6.3: ime āsavāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti …pe… ayaṃ āsavanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an3.59:6.4: tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati
an3.59:6.6: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti
an3.59:6.8: avijjā vihatā vijjā uppannā tamo vihato āloko uppanno yathātaṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharatoti.
an3.59:10.1: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa ariyassa vinaye tevijjo hotīti.
an3.59:10.2: aññathā bho gotama brāhmaṇānaṃ tevijjo aññathā ca pana ariyassa vinaye tevijjo hoti
an3.59:10.3: imassa ca bho gotama ariyassa vinaye tevijjassa brāhmaṇānaṃ tevijjo kalaṃ nāgghati soḷsiṃ
an3.59:11.2: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
